title: Genetically supported targets and drug repurposing for brain aging: A systematic study in the UK Biobank
body:
##  Genetically supported targets and drug repurposing for brain aging: A systematic study in the UK Biobank 

In the March 2025 issue of Science Advances [Yi et al. ](<https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11900869/>)reported the development of a brain age estimation model using large-scale genetic and imaging data. Brain age gap (BAG) is a digital phenotype that may reflect associations with various brain disorders. This study aimed to identify potential drug targets causally associated with BAG. A total of 64 genes were identified within five Reactome pathways: [programmed cell death](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-5357801>), [platelet signaling and aggregation](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-76002>) , [extracellular matrix organization](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-1474244>), [cell surface interactions at the vascular wall](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-202733>), and [apoptosis](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-109581>) Of these, seven genes were prioritized as targets due to strong genetic evidence for BAG.
